appDesc.message: Block YouTube channels in one click, plus speed, crop, clips and colour. Open source, clean and collects no data.

modalDesc.message: The YouTube page needs to be refreshed to hide the skip animation. Refresh now?

invertHint.message: Turns a bright whiteboard lecture into a dark one while keeping hues readable.

allowPanelsHint.message: Chapters, transcript and the AI panel still open when you ask for them, and close again on the next video.

speedEnabledHint.message: Turn this off to hand playback speed back to YouTube or another speed extension. Nothing is touched while it is off.

speedPresetHint.message: Presets set the default speed. Fine steps live on the speed button in the player controls and the shortcuts.

cropHint.message: Adds a crop button to the player controls. Drag over the video to choose the area to keep; it fills the player while the video keeps playing. Click the button again to see the whole video. The crop ends with the video.

cropFit.message: When the area's shape differs from the player

clipHint.message: Opens a clip bar on the player. Mark a start and end, then save — the range is recorded in real time from your own playback and downloaded as a video file.

channelAutoVideosHint.message: Channel links jump straight to the Videos tab instead of the channel home page.

focusMode.message: Focus mode active — the home feed is hidden.

clipNoRange.message: Set a start and end point first

muteAdsHint.message: Ads play silently; the sound comes back at the same volume as soon as the ad ends.

blockedEmpty.message: No blocked channels yet. Hover over a recommended video and press 🚫 to block its channel.

cropSelectHint.message: Drag over the video to choose the area to keep · Esc cancels

masterToggle.message: Turn the extension on or off

offNotice.message: Paused — YouTube runs untouched until you turn it back on.

introText1.message: Speed, clip and crop sit in YouTube's own control bar, next to settings.

introTitle2.message: Block a channel in one click

introText2.message: Hover over a recommended video and press 🚫. Its channel's videos are covered from then on.

introText3.message: Open a card to change it, search for any setting, and press the keyboard icon beside a setting to give it a shortcut.

hideShortsHint.message: Removes Shorts shelves, search results, the menu entry and the channel tab. A Shorts link opens as a normal video.
